data.name: Glow
data.subtitle: Clean, powerful Facebook tweak by dayanch96
data.localizedDescription: Glow is a simple, clean and powerful tweak for Facebook by Dayanch96: it removes ads and sponsored content, adds video downloads, unlocks media quality options and hides unwanted UI elements on top of the official Facebook app.

compatibility.notes: Tracks the ready-to-sideload Glow build from the IPA Vault source (the official dayanch96/Glow repo publishes the tweak as .deb only). Facebook 577.x builds require iOS 15.1 or newer. Uses its own bundle identifier, so it installs alongside the stock App Store Facebook.
